'''Reaver Squadron''' was a [[Predator-class fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] loyal to [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The squadron participate on the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].
